name: Reed Turns the Edge
target_html: Self, against one melee attack.
effect_html: Trigger: A melee Action would deal Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1 before it accumulates.
surge1_html: After the attack, move 1 unit away from its source.
surge2_html: Reduce the Damage by 1 more.

name: Pebble Trips the Heel
target_html: One enemy that starts within 1 unit of you.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy voluntarily begins moving away from you. Response: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage after its first unit of movement.
surge1_html: On a hit, reduce its remaining Movement this turn by 1.
surge2_html: On a hit, follow 1 unit without triggering movement Reactions.

name: Heron Answers the Spear
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy misses you with a melee Action. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit around the target after the attack.
surge2_html: If hit, gain 1 additional Combo.

name: Hound Follows the Ribbon
target_html: Self; one visible enemy within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: That enemy finishes voluntary movement farther from you. Response (unopposed): Move up to 2 units toward it, without triggering its movement Reactions.
surge1_html: Increase this movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Gain +1 Fortitude against that enemy until the start of your next turn.

name: Viper Closes the Circle
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy fails an Action while adjacent to you. Response: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage. You may spend 2 Combo after a hit to knock it Prone.
surge1_html: On a hit, pull the target 1 unit.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target is Prone.

name: Bell Swallows the Hammer
target_html: Self or an adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Trigger: A melee Action would push or pull the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that forced movement by 2 units.
surge1_html: The target also reduces Damage from that Action by 1.
surge2_html: After the Action, move its attacker 1 unit away from the protected creature if adjacent to you; compare your Success Die to its Fortitude.

name: Two Blades Make a Roof
target_html: Self or an adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature, before its roll. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 Fortitude against that attack.
surge1_html: After the attack, the protected creature may move 1 unit toward you.
surge2_html: If the attack hits, reduce its Damage to that creature by 1.

name: Thunder Returns to the Hill
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy deals Damage to you with an Action. Response: After its Damage resolves, on success deal 2 weapon Damage to it.
surge1_html: If hit, push it 1 unit.
surge2_html: If hit, suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties on yourself until the start of your next turn.

name: Cranes Trade the Watch
target_html: One willing ally within 2 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An attack targets the ally, before its roll. Response (unopposed): Move into an empty space adjacent to it and take its place as the target, if the attacker can legally target you; gain +1 Fortitude against that attack.
surge1_html: The ally may move 1 unit away without triggering movement Reactions.
surge2_html: Reduce the attack's Damage to you by 1.

name: Eel Loosens the Fisher's Knot
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction successfully restrains you or makes you Prone. Response (unopposed): Suppress that one effect until the Action finishes, then move 1 unit. End the effect if you leave its source's reach; otherwise it resumes.
surge1_html: Move 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: Reduce Damage from the triggering Action by 1.

name: Wheel Cuts the Returning Road
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: A Prone or Slowed enemy voluntarily moves or stands. Response: After that movement or standing, on success deal 1 weapon Damage and push it 1 unit.
surge1_html: On a hit, move into its vacated space.
surge2_html: Spend 2 Combo on a hit to deal +1 weapon Damage and knock it Prone.

name: Duck Behind the Stock
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: A ranged Action would deal Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1.
surge1_html: After the attack, move 1 unit toward cover.
surge2_html: Reduce its Damage by 1 more if you already have cover.

name: Snap Line
target_html: One visible enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy finishes voluntary movement out of cover. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore ordinary concealment for this shot.
surge2_html: After resolving, establish Lock on the target.

name: Track the Muzzle
target_html: Self; your visible Locked target.
effect_html: Trigger: Your Locked target declares a ranged Action against you, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Gain +1 Fortitude against that Action.
surge1_html: If it misses, preserve Lock through its next move behind cover until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: End Lock to reduce Damage from that Action by 1.

name: Crossing Shot
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy crosses a visible gap of at least 1 unit between cover sources. Response: After that movement, on success deal 1 weapon Damage and make it Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow by 1.
surge2_html: If hit and Locked, end Lock to impose -1 on its next ranged Success Die until the start of your next turn.

name: Cut the Angle
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: A ranged Action targets you, before its roll. Response (unopposed): Move 1 unit and gain +1 Fortitude against that Action. The attack is rechecked from your new space.
surge1_html: Move 1 additional unit, but only toward cover.
surge2_html: Your movement does not trigger movement Reactions from the attacker.

name: Return a Favor
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy's ranged Action misses you or an ally within 2 units. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge2_html: Also attack a second enemy within 2 units of the first with the same roll for 1 weapon Damage.

name: Leave Nothing Open
target_html: Your visible Locked target within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The target fails an Action while Slowed or Distracted. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: On a hit, push it 1 unit out of its current space.
surge2_html: After a hit, end Lock to deal +1 weapon Damage.

name: Break Contact
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An enemy Action would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1; after the Action, the protected creature may move 2 units.
surge1_html: The movement does not trigger movement Reactions from the attacker.
surge2_html: Reduce the Damage by 1 more if its source is your Locked target.

name: Intercept the Payload
target_html: Self or a willing ally within ranged Weapon Range and within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: A visible physical projectile Action would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 2. This cannot intercept beams, areas or nonprojectile effects.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit after the attack.
surge2_html: Also suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by that projectile until the start of your next turn.

name: Answer in Stereo
target_html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: An enemy ranged Action misses you while another enemy is within 2 units of its source. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage to each selected target.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus against one target.
surge2_html: One hit target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

name: Last Clear Window
target_html: Your visible Locked target within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The target declares a defensive Action, before its benefits apply. Response: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage before that Action continues.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge2_html: After a hit, end Lock to suppress 1 point of the declared Action's ordinary defensive bonus until the start of your next turn. The Action is not canceled.

name: Flexile Impact
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal physical Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1.
surge1_html: After the attack, move 1 unit.
surge2_html: Reduce the Damage by 1 more, but become Unstable until your next turn.

name: Contact Quills
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy misses you with a bodily melee Action. Response: On success, deal 1 Piercing Damage.
surge1_html: After a hit, move 1 unit away.
surge2_html: On a hit, the enemy is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: Predatory Intercept
target_html: One enemy adjacent after it moves.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to you. Response: On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore ordinary concealment for this attack.
surge2_html: After a hit, pull the target 1 unit.

name: Sacrificial Carapace
target_html: Self or one adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1. You may end your Adaptation to reduce it by 1 more.
surge1_html: Suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by the Action until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties on yourself until the start of your next turn.

name: Mass Redistribution
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would push, pull or knock you Prone. Response (unopposed): Reduce forced movement by 2 units and prevent its Prone effect.
surge1_html: After resolving, move 1 unit along a supported surface.
surge2_html: Reduce Damage from that Action by 1.

name: Elastic Recoil
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: A melee Action targets you before rolling. Response (unopposed): Move 1 unit and gain +1 Fortitude against it. Recheck its target validity afterward.
surge1_html: Your movement ignores difficult terrain.
surge2_html: Move 1 additional unit away from the attacker.

name: Borrowed Reflex Arc
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction targets you while you have an Adaptation, before its roll. Response (unopposed): Retain or end that Adaptation; gain +1 to the targeted Defense against the Action.
surge1_html: Detect the attacker's space if it is within 3 units and not behind a solid barrier.
surge2_html: If you ended the Adaptation, reduce Damage from the Action by 1.

name: Rebound Anatomy
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy pushes you or knocks you Prone with an Action. Response: After its effect, on success deal 2 Bludgeoning Damage and stand if there is room.
surge1_html: On a hit, push the enemy 1 unit.
surge2_html: On a hit, move it to another empty adjacent space and remain adjacent.

name: Organ Shutter
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce the Damage by 2, then become Unstable until your next turn.
surge1_html: Suppress one ordinary Poison Condition until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one non-Critical physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn.

name: Slingtail Rescue
target_html: One willing ally within 2 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An area Action is declared that includes the ally, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Pull the ally up to 2 units toward you along a clear path, then recheck whether it remains in the area.
surge1_html: Increase the pull by 1 unit.
surge2_html: If it remains in the area, reduce that Action's Damage to it by 1.

name: Nerve-Route Diversion
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would impose an ordinary sensory or Movement-limiting Condition on you. Response (unopposed): Suppress that Condition until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Detect the source's space if it is within 3 units and not behind a solid barrier.
surge2_html: Also reduce Damage from the Action by 1; your current Adaptation ends.
